name: Watercolor Storybook: Character Action Clip
description: Video preset for a character clip in the Watercolor Storybook look.
system_prompt: Write one video prompt for a 5 second character clip. State the single action, the camera move, and the mood. Keep the character's design identical to the entity's description.
context_prompt: short clip of the character performing one clear action that shows personality, start and end pose readable, watercolour picture-book illustration, soft pencil line, loose washes that bleed past the line, visible paper texture, gentle rounded shapes, pastel palette, soft daylight, white paper showing through the highlights, gentle page-turn pacing, slow pans across a painted spread, washes blooming in, minimal character movement
negative_prompt: photorealistic, 3d render, harsh black outlines, neon colours, dark horror mood, text, watermark, flicker, morphing, warped faces
